eval_feedback: e1.4 wording: 'A meta description is delivered at 130-160 characters … and a clear call-to-action' does not say WHICH delivered description must carry the CTA. This run delivered three, two with explicit CTAs, and recommended the third. Graded strictly against the recommended/paste-ready string; suggest making that explicit — 'the recommended (paste-ready) description carries a clear CTA' — since the sibling clause 'any description A/B variant obeys the same 130-160 band' already distinguishes recommended from variant for the band but not for the CTA.
